meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 遇到 git 任务时,它会先看仓库状态和近期提交风格,再把改动拆成多个条理清楚的小提交,并沿用仓库的写法写提交说明;处理历史时能合并、重排提交,也能查出某段代码是谁在何时加的。
howto.when: 当用户发出任何 git 操作请求时接管,包括但不限于包含“commit”、“rebase”、“squash”等触发词的请求。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动拆成几个提交,按目录或功能分一下。
say.note: 它会按目录和功能拆分,而不是一次提交。

say.text: 把最近三次提交合并成一次,并写清楚这次改了什么。
say.note: 它会用 rebase 整理并合并这些提交。

say.text: 查一下 Login.tsx 里第 10 行是谁写的,什么时候加的。
say.note: 它会用 blame 和日志找出提交人与时间。

howto.what_en: On any git request it checks repo state and recent commit style, then splits changes into focused atomic commits written per that style; when cleaning history it squashes or reorders commits; and it can trace which commit/author introduced a code line.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user asks for any git operation, including phrasing with 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or similar trigger words.

say_en.text: Split these file changes into separate commits grouped by directory or feature.
say_en.note: It analyzes then groups related changes.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one and describe clearly what changed.
Find who wrote line 10 of Login.tsx and when it was added.
say_en.note: It searches commit history and blame.
